items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 7:1
items.html: Since the Mochin were divided between ZA and the Nukva — the right side, which is Hochma and Hesed, became Makifim over ZA, and the Nukva took only the aspect of the left side of the Mochin, namely the Binot and Gevurot alone, like the upper Ima herself — these Mochin are discerned as an aspect of Hochma without Hassadim, like the upper Ima at the time she ascends to AB and returns to be Hochma, in whom there is then only the aspect of Hochma alone, without Hassadim, that is, in the measure of the Hochma of the direct light. See above in Part 1, Page 5, s.v. and the reason.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 7:2
items.html: (To the question) And behold, the Bina that returned to be Hochma does not need there the aspect of Hassadim, for Bina is the very essence of Hochma from the root of its emanation in the direct light, being an aspect of expansion from the Hochma of the direct light in the root of its emanation. Therefore the light of Ein Sof clothes in her through the Hochma, and nothing more is needed. Not so ZON, who are the expansion of the Hassadim from Bina, from the very essence of their emanation, except that there is in them an illumination of the light of Hochma, as above in Page 5, s.v. and the reason. If so, Hochma is not received in them except by clothing within the Hassadim, as the Rav wrote in Shaar HaKavanot, on Yom Kippur, see there. Therefore the Nukva could not use a single Keter with ZA, for she could not stand in those Mochin, since she was lacking Hassadim: for ZA received Hochma and Hesed as Makifim, and in the Mochin there was only Binot and Gevurot alone, namely Hochma without Hassadim. Therefore also the Hochma was not clothed in them as it should be. And she requested of the Emanator that He bestow upon her an influx of Hassadim, so that the Hochma would clothe in them; then it was said to her, go and diminish yourself, meaning that she return to the point below the Yesod, and come a second time in Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin, from the Hesed of face to face, so that she would receive the Mochin upon feminine MAN; then she would have the aspect of Hochma and Hassadim together, as they are in ZA. (Item 5).
